AcceptIn.description:
The versions the user read on the acceptance screen, for one role. The 18+ declaration
must be true (minors cannot contract).
AcceptIn.title: AcceptIn

AccountDeleted.description:
The server holds none of the grower's records or photos any more.
`sign_in_account_removed` is false when the sign-in account is left for the owner to
remove by hand (no service role key configured, or Supabase did not answer).
AccountDeleted.title: AccountDeleted

AnswerIn.description: One question: 1-5 stars and optional tag ids (no text, Q66).
AnswerIn.title: AnswerIn

ArticleOut.description: Spec v1.6: the AI article from the official source, in the asked language.
ArticleOut.title: ArticleOut

BadgeOut.description:
What was checked and when; the app words it "checked on <date>", never a guarantee.
`checked`: an admin approval on record; `registered_from`: the registration GPS fix's
place; `place_photo`: a BagMitra representative's visit photo. L7, one per passed check
on a free official page (spec §4 table), shown once the profile is approved:
`gst_checked` (with `since_year`, the GST registration year), `apmc_seen`,
`fssai_checked`, `iec_active`, `apeda_listed`.
BadgeOut.title: BadgeOut

BillLimitsOut.description:
Bill reading limits (Q136) for farmers without a role plan (or while the switch is off);
null = the default. `daily_total`: all farmers together per India day; null = no cap.
BillLimitsOut.title: BillLimitsOut

BlockedClaimOut.description:
A label row whose active ingredient is banned, or restricted for this crop: shown in
red so the grower knows it, never with a dose.
BlockedClaimOut.title: BlockedClaimOut

photo.description: One JPEG or PNG photo of the bill
photo.title: Photo

BuyerIn.description:
A trader or an exporter: firm, the markets / villages they buy in, crops, and the
registration numbers they hold (stored for the admin's manual check).
BuyerIn.title: BuyerIn

BuyerLotOut.description:
A published lot for a verified buyer / broker: exactly the fields of spec v1.5 §4E.
The grower's first name only; no surname, owner, phone, village, plot or point (decision
g); `acres` is the plot's area.
BuyerLotOut.title: BuyerLotOut

CurrentConditions.description:
The provider's reading for the plot's location at `observed_at` (UTC), for the home
header (Q140). Served from a short per-location cache; an older reading keeps its own
time, so the phone can tell how old it is.
CurrentConditions.title: CurrentConditions

DealRatingsOut.description: The caller's own ratings on the deal (to show and change them) and the window.
DealRatingsOut.title: DealRatingsOut

DealStateOut.description: Where the deal stands for the caller: who tapped "deal done", and the rating window.
DealStateOut.title: DealStateOut

FeedAdminDatesIn.description: All four dates at once: a missing or `null` date is cleared.
FeedAdminDatesIn.title: FeedAdminDatesIn

FeedPreferencesBody.description:
Quiet hours are India local times "HH:MM" (start inclusive, end exclusive; equal
means no quiet hours). `weekly_cap` counts alert pushes in any rolling 7 days.
FeedPreferencesBody.title: FeedPreferencesBody

GrievanceOfficerOut.description: IT Rules 2021 grievance officer. `name` null: the owner (default, spec §4C).
GrievanceOfficerOut.title: GrievanceOfficerOut

GrowerInterestOut.description:
An interest beside the others: the trader's (and broker's) public profile with the
verified badge, completed-deal count and stars (spec §3 step 4).
GrowerInterestOut.title: GrowerInterestOut

GrowerLotOut.description: The server-set state of the grower's own lot after publish / close.
GrowerLotOut.title: GrowerLotOut

InterestIn.description:
Spec §3 step 3, nothing more. `rate_paise` is per tonne, per crate or the whole amount,
by `basis`. A trader may name a broker (`broker_id`); a broker names the trader
(`trader_id`) it brings. Unknown keys (terms, commission, payer ...) are refused.
InterestIn.title: InterestIn

IntroductionOut.description: Both sides' contacts after acceptance; nothing about their deal is recorded.
IntroductionOut.title: IntroductionOut

LotBrief.description: What the sender already saw in the lot list: never the grower's identity.
LotBrief.title: LotBrief

LotPhotoStored.description: The stored photo's key, to record on the photo through the outbox.
LotPhotoStored.title: LotPhotoStored

LotPhotoUrl.description: A short-lived link to a lot photo (no key, no point: spec v1.5 §4B).
LotPhotoUrl.title: LotPhotoUrl

LotPhotoView.description: A lot photo as a buyer sees it: no GPS point (it would show where the plot is).
LotPhotoView.title: LotPhotoView

MyProfileOut.description: The registrant's own view: status of the latest check and why the admin looks at it.
MyProfileOut.title: MyProfileOut

OfficialLinkOut.description: A button on the admin page: the page to open and the number to type into it.
OfficialLinkOut.title: OfficialLinkOut

PackageCompanyIn.description:
Every field optional; an empty string clears it. The bank account keeps its last 4
digits only (§4E).
PackageCompanyIn.title: PackageCompanyIn

PackageCover.description: An active package: one lot, or every lot of the grower when `lot_id` is null.
PackageCover.title: PackageCover

PackageStatus.description:
The grower's own season package status (spec v1.5 §4E): dates only. No amount, price,
UPI ID or payment detail ever reaches the app (consumption-only).
PackageStatus.title: PackageStatus

PhotoLimitsOut.description:
Photo analysis limits for farmers without a role plan (or while the switch is off);
null = the default. `daily_total`: all farmers together per India day; null = no cap.
PhotoLimitsOut.title: PhotoLimitsOut

PlanOfferOut.description: Subscription page (§7) only while ON and a role is priced; the price is Play's own.
PlanOfferOut.title: PlanOfferOut

RatingIn.description: Every question of the rated role, once each.
RatingIn.title: RatingIn

ReceiptGst.description: GST included in the amount received (shown only with GSTIN and a rate).
ReceiptGst.title: ReceiptGst

RelatedOut.description: Another profile this one matches, and on what.
RelatedOut.title: RelatedOut

ReportIn.description: Codes only: any other key (a text, a comment) is refused.
ReportIn.title: ReportIn

put.description: Bill reading limits for farmers without a plan, and the optional overall cap (Q136).
Photo analysis limits for farmers without a plan, and the optional overall cap (Q135).
Bill reading limits per farmer on this role's plan (Q136).
Photo analysis limits per farmer on this role's plan (Q135).

get.description: The review queue by default (`status=in_review`), newest first.

post.description: Manual upload: metadata, optional document (hashed), optional text. Lands in review.

Classify and summarise the item's text into a review draft (AI off without
FEED_AI_API_KEY). Irrelevant documents move to `draft`, out of the queue.

put.description:
Replace deadline / payment / validity dates (a missing or `null` date is cleared). The
dates are output-checked against the stored text; a change to a published item clears its
approval and sends it back to review (an `edited` event with `reopened: true`); the
farmer-facing deadlines are rebuilt when it is published again. Withdrawn: 409.

Record the owner's check of the source's terms of use and robots. Also clears a
recorded fetch failure, so the next scheduled run tries once more.

Record a document an admin downloaded by hand (the server could not fetch it). The body
is the raw file; only its hash, size and time are kept.

get.description: The action log, newest first (at most 200 rows).

post.description: An action without a report (e.g. restore after a check, or hide a duplicate user).

get.description: Appeals in one state, oldest appeal first.

post.description:
Uphold (a hide / suspend is lifted by a new restore row, reason `appeal_upheld`) or
reject. Decided once.

put.description:
Saves the fields sent (an empty string clears one). While the switch is ON a guard
field cannot be cleared.
The bank's merchant QR image (PNG / JPEG) for the representatives' printed card.

get.description: Grants newest first (one grower's with `grower_id`).

post.description:
Records a payment received outside the app and activates the package: the lot (or
every lot of the grower) is shown to traders until `valid_until`. 409
`duplicate_payment_ref` for a used UTR; 409 `package_fields_missing` while legal name,
GSTIN, UPI ID, price or validity is empty.

get.description:
What the receipt PDF shows (the admin web draws it): company profile, receipt number,
grower, amount, GST line only when GSTIN and GST rate are set, payment reference and
validity. 409 `company_profile_empty` while legal name or address is empty.

post.description:
Ends the grant now with a reason (logged); the lot hides from traders if no other
grant covers it.

get.description: Growers with this mobile number (10 digits, with or without +91) and their lots.

put.description:
Switch, price, validity, start date. The switch cannot turn (or stay) ON while legal
name, GSTIN, UPI ID or price is empty: 409 `package_fields_missing` names the fields.

post.description:
Admin adds a provider it knows (no account of its own, spec §2); it waits in the queue
for a decision like any other (Q72).

get.description: Every tag, drafts and retired ones included.

put.description: Edit the three labels and set draft / active / retired (spec §3A: admin only).

get.description: Checks the yearly job listed as due and not re-checked since, oldest first.
Reports in one state, oldest first (the grievance timeline runs from creation).

post.description:
Warn, hide or suspend the reported subject with a reason code; this closes every open
report of the same subject with that action.
No platform rule is broken: the report closes without an action.

get.description: Subjects waiting for a check (latest record pending, or none yet), oldest first.
The subject's submitted fields, documents, every verification and check record.

post.description: Record one check done by hand on the official page: a new record with who and when.

get.description: A short-lived signed URL for one stored document; only keys on record are signed.

post.description: Store prices typed in from a mandi's published rate list (same day and mandi replace).

get.description:
Training export: labelled samples with a signed photo link (1 hour) and the label.
`labelled=false` lists the samples still to label. No owner id is listed.

put.description: Confirms what a sample shows (a profile key, `healthy` or `other`) for training.

get.description: Latest and minimum app version codes (0 = not set) and where to download the APK.

post.description:
A signed upload URL for this record's bill photo (JPEG only, at most `max_bytes`).

The phone PUTs the file to `upload_url`, then records `photo_key` as the record's
`bill_photo_key` through the normal outbox.

get.description:
A short-lived signed download URL for a backed-up bill photo. Only the key derived
from the caller and the record is ever signed; a stored key that differs is no photo.

post.description: Pub/Sub push of a Play notification (no user session: Google's OIDC token instead).

The app sends the purchase token; only after Google confirms it does the snapshot
change. The server acknowledges the purchase.

Reads one agri-input shop bill photo (owner Q136). Nothing of the photo or the result
is stored; only a count row for the limits.

429 `bill_read_limit`: `error.details` has `limit` (daily | monthly | total), `max` and
`resets_at` (UTC); the `Retry-After` header has the seconds until then. 503
`analysis_unavailable`: no API key on the server. 502 `analysis_failed`: the model could
not answer; nothing is counted.

get.description:
Newest first. `district` / `crop` narrow the list to items meant for them (items for
everyone always pass); `may_be_eligible_because` is computed from the caller's own
profile and plots.

post.description:
Compares the pasted text with published official items only. Never says a message is
fake: without a match the note says none was found and points to the official portal.
Hide the item from the caller's pushes (reminders and digest stop for it).

Record that the caller wants this item's date reminders even if it was not matched to
their profile; undoes a dismiss. Only for a published item that has a date.

get.description: Enrolment dates of published official crop insurance notices, soonest first.
The general part of every live knowledge card (newest version per topic and crop).
Every admin action about the caller, newest first, with its reason code (§4C).

post.description: The one appeal against a warn, hide or suspend; the grievance officer decides.
Adds one optional JPEG to the caller's open appeal (EXIF stripped by the server).

put.description: Block a user: neither sees the other in lists or interests. Repeating it is a no-op.

post.description:
Broker (मध्यस्थ (दलाल)) registration: phone sign-in + GPS fix; the admin then calls
(spec §4 broker rule; no photo ID, no place photo needed).

get.description: The introduction, for its grower, trader and broker only (404 for anyone else).

post.description:
The grower or the trader says the deal is done (a repeat tap changes nothing). When
both have tapped, the deal is completed and rating opens for 7 days (Q66, Q67).

get.description: The caller's ratings on this deal, the questions to answer and the window.

put.description:
Give or change the caller's rating of one party of a completed deal: every question
of that role once. Only within 7 days of completion, then 409 `rating_locked`; accounts
seen on one phone cannot rate each other (409 `same_device`, spec §4C).

post.description: Exporter registration (IEC required, spec §4).

get.description:
Interests where the caller is the trader or the named broker, newest first, with the
lot and, once accepted, the introduction to open; a closed one is the notice that the
grower accepted another or closed the lot.

post.description:
The lot's grower accepts one open interest: the introduction is recorded, the other
open interests are closed (their senders get a notice), the lot leaves the traders' list
and both sides see each other's contacts. Anyone but the lot's grower gets 404.

put.description:
Uploads one JPEG of the caller's own draft lot through the server, which strips its
EXIF (GPS point, phone model, time) before storing it (spec v1.5 §4B). There is no signed
upload URL for lot photos, so no stored lot photo can keep its metadata.

get.description:
A short-lived download URL for an uploaded lot photo: for the grower, or for a
verified buyer / broker while `lot_visible_to_traders` shows the lot, or for the parties
of an accepted interest on it (L4). Only the derived key is signed.

Published lots, newest first, for admin-verified buyers and brokers only (403
`not_verified` for anyone else); while the season package is ON, only lots with an active
package (§4E). Page with `before` = the last `published_at` seen.

post.description:
Takes a published lot off the buyers' list (the grower sold it or changed their mind);
its open interests are closed and their senders get a notice (L4).

get.description:
The interests on the caller's own lot, oldest first, to compare side by side. An
interest whose trader or broker is no longer verified (decision h), is hidden, suspended
or deleted, or blocked either way with the grower (§4C), is left out.

post.description:
An interest on a published lot from a verified trader / exporter (optionally naming a
verified broker) or from a verified broker for a named verified trader. A trader's new
interest replaces their open one on the same lot. The grower gets a push.

Shows a draft lot to verified buyers and brokers. Needs 3 to 8 live photos, each
uploaded; crop and variety are copied from the plot again and the place names from the
grower's profile (village, taluka, district; never the plot's point).

get.description: What the signed-in user accepted, and the roles it opens.
Every market-link profile of the signed-in user, with its check status.

While the switch is ON, the caller's active packages (end dates); the app shows
"package active until <date>" or "not active" on each published lot.

The list per taluka (decision g): verified traders, exporters or brokers, by rating
(mean of the question averages; unrated last) or by completed deals. Hidden, suspended,
deleted and blocked (either way) profiles are left out (§4C).

One verified profile; an unverified, hidden, suspended, deleted or blocked one answers
404 as if absent.

put.description:
The optional address: only the profile owner or a BagMitra representative sets it
(addendum 2); who and when are stored, and a representative's entry is also a record.

post.description:
A document photo for the admin's check (in-app camera): GSTIN / APMC / FSSAI / IEC /
APEDA for a trader or exporter, the Legal Metrology certificate (with its valid-until
date) for a weighbridge. Owner only; EXIF stripped before storage (spec §4B).

A representative's place photo from a visit (in-app camera, time + GPS): who and when
are stored; EXIF is stripped before storage (addendum 2, spec §4B).

get.description:
Verified providers near the grower's own plot: nearest first when both have a location
(distance in whole km from the provider's registration fix, Q80), the rest by district,
taluka and name. A phone number to call; no booking.

post.description: Service provider registration (one per kind per user) with the GPS fix.

get.description: The active tick list under each rating question (spec §3A); the app caches it.

post.description:
Report to the admin queue. A second report of the same subject by the same person
while the first is open returns the first.
Adds one optional JPEG to the caller's open report (EXIF stripped by the server).

get.description:
The current version of each document accepted before a role is used, and the
grievance officer shown on every role home (spec §4C).

post.description:
Record the acceptance of every document for one role. A version that is no longer
current answers 409 `terms_version_changed`, so the app shows the new text again.
Trader registration with the GPS fix; lands in the verification queue.

get.description:
Latest published price (₹ per quintal) at every reporting mandi in India for the crop:
the local APMCs first, then the major terminal markets, then all others by state. Prices
are shown as published, never estimated, and come from storage only (filled by the scheduled
pull; a request never fetches). `stale` says they are not current and `reason` says why.
`scope` narrows the list to local or major mandis.

Owner 2026-11-09 (price trend chart): the stored price (₹ per quintal) of one mandi for
each day of the last `days` days (at most 90), oldest first, as published. A day without a
published price is absent, never estimated. `variety` / `grade` are as in /market/prices
(empty when the source left them blank); `stale` / `reason` as there.

delete.description:
Erase the caller's account: every record, the sync history, devices, notice receipts,
backed-up photos and (when configured) the sign-in account. It cannot be undone.
Market-link profiles and lots are hidden at once and erased after 180 days (Q68).
Stop push alerts to this phone (sign-out); unknown tokens are ignored.

post.description:
Register this phone for push alerts; repeating it is harmless. With the market link on,
the account is also remembered on this phone (hashed token) so that two accounts on one
phone cannot rate each other (spec v1.5 §4C, Q100).

get.description: The caller's settings, or the defaults (21:00-07:00, 3 a week, digest on).

delete.description:
Deletes the caller's own analysed photo and its result (also when the app deletes the
scouting entry it belongs to). 502 when storage fails; nothing is deleted then.

post.description:
Analyses one crop photo of the caller's own plot (owner Q135).

429 `analysis_limit`: `error.details` has `limit` (daily | monthly | total), `max` and
`resets_at` (UTC); the `Retry-After` header has the seconds until then. 503
`analysis_unavailable`: no API key on the server. 502 `analysis_failed`: the model could
not answer; nothing is stored or counted.

get.description:
Recent and forecast days for the plot's location, with rule-based risk alerts, and
the current reading there (null when the provider has given none).

Alerts come only from the configured rules (never from AI) and carry no chemical advice.

What CIB&RC registered labels say for the crop (owner, 2026-10-26: label information
only). Only claims valid today whose active ingredient is neither banned nor restricted
for the crop pass the legal gate; doses are quoted exactly as the label states them.
The app shows this as label information with "read the label; confirm with KVK", never
as BagMitra's own advice.

Gazette bans / restrictions and trade names, cached by the app so spray records can
be checked offline. Facts only; no advice text.

post.description:
A signed upload URL for this record's photo (JPEG only, at most `max_bytes`).

The phone PUTs the file to `upload_url` with `Content-Type: image/jpeg`, then records
`photo_key` on the scouting record through the normal outbox.

get.description:
A short-lived signed download URL for a backed-up photo.

Only the key derived from the caller and the record is ever signed (S-03): the stored
`photo_key` is just the flag that a photo exists, and one that does not match the derived
key (written around the sync check) is treated as no photo.

post.description:
Apply a batch of offline mutations. Each mutation gets its own result; the batch
never fails as a whole because of one bad mutation.
